# Shaswat Raj

## Summary

- Merged pull requests in google-gemini/gemini-cli (#20778), preactjs/preact (#5331), codex-team/editor.js (#3040) and mofa-org/mofa (#1577, #1587, #1594); more in review at Jaeger, Kmesh, Lexical and Radix UI.
- Tech lead for Bitotsav '26, a festival platform for about 5,000 participants.
- Built and runs SopKit, 605+ client-side browser tools (4.3M+ requests in 30 days).
